svg.aria-label: How a stop compares. wsl --shutdown: no time for services, containers cut mid-write, back only by their policy. docker stop: time for containers only, unless-stopped lost, only those set to always back. wsl-spawner: each service its own time, policies kept, containers back as you choose, runs last at sign-out, says how it went.
